_about: Decisions a person made about company logos, read by scripts/fetch-logos.mjs and never undone by a run. `none`: domains left on the lettermark, each with the reason. `kept`: marks placed by hand (the file is in client/public/logos/), each with where it came from. Add to either with: node scripts/fetch-logos.mjs --place a.com=mark.svg --note "..." or --none a.com --note "..."
